tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: FREE. What data Awardia holds: sources, countries, date range, number of open tenders and award notices. Useful to check before searching a country or period.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Free during beta. Find OPEN public tenders (deadline still in the future) by keywords, country, region, CPV sector and value. tools.name: match_company
tools.description: Free during beta. Describe a company in plain words (what it sells, where). Returns the open public tenders it could bid on, best match first, each with 'competition' signals from the buyer's past contracts (median bidders, single-bid share, % below estimate).

tools.name: award_history
tools.description: Free during beta. Who won past public contracts, at what price, against how many bidders, and by which procedure (open call, prior consultation, direct award). Filter by buyer, winner, CPV sector and region. For Portugal covers every public contract (Portal BASE), incl. small direct awards. Returns

tools.name: bid_intelligence
tools.description: Free during beta. Should I bid, and at what price? For an open tender (tender_id from search_tenders/match_company, or a pasted tender link) or a buyer+sector, analyses comparable past contracts: typical number of bidders, share of single-bid contests, how far below the estimate winners bid, a price

tools.name: expiring_contracts
tools.description: Free during beta. Public contracts whose term ends soon, so the buyer will likely re-tender: a sales pipeline before tenders are published. Returns buyer, incumbent supplier(s), value, start and expected end date.

tools.name: competitor_profile
